description: This file is a source code file from the PyTorch Inductor JIT compiler, specifically implementing the GraphLowering class responsible for lowering Torch FX graphs into inductor IR, managing buffers, operations, layouts, and codegen. It contains various utility functions, class definitions, and mechanisms for graph optimization, layout decisions, buffer management, and integration with other PyTorch modules.

classes.name: GraphLowering
classes.description: A class that performs graph lowering from Torch FX graph to inductor IR, managing buffers, operations, layouts, and code generation, with utility methods for buffer management, layout decisions, inlining constants, and graph transformations.

methods.name: None freeze_runtime_asserts(self)
methods.description: Freezes all runtime assertions in the shape environment to prevent further modifications.

methods.description: Returns symbolic sizes and strides for a tensor, supporting dynamic shapes and strides.

methods.name: static_sizes_strides
methods.description: Returns static (concrete) sizes and strides of a tensor.

methods.description: Computes the allocation size for a buffer or tensor box, considering padded sizes.

methods.description: Computes the required storage size for a buffer considering layout offset and strides.
